age.evidence: Adult male and female mice were used for all the experiments in this study.

sex.evidence: Adult male and female mice were used for all the experiments in this study.

dosing.doses_raw: 2 mg/kg, 10 ml/kg, i.p.; 0.5 mg/kg, 10 ml/kg, i.p.
dosing.evidence: WT and SRKO mice (n = 6 per group) were injected with either (±)-2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine hydrochloride (DOI: ... 2 mg/kg, 10 ml/kg, i.p.) or a corresponding volume of saline. In a second cohort, WT and SRKO mice (n = 5 to 6 per group) were injected with either DOI (0.5 mg/kg, 10 ml/kg, i.p.) or a corresponding volume of saline.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed in groups of four in polycarbonate cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12:12 h light/dark cycle

assays.assay_description: Mice were injected i.p. with DOI (0.5 or 2 mg/kg) or saline, immediately moved to a standard cage (15 × 24 cm) without enrichment, and videotaped for 25 min. The total number of head-twitches was scored by a blinded observer in the interval between 5 and 25 min post-injection. First cohort used a crossover design (DOI vs saline one week apart); second cohort was single-day.

outcomes.summary: DOI (0.5 and 2 mg/kg, i.p.) robustly increased head-twitch response in both WT and SRKO mice, but SRKO mice displayed a significantly attenuated HTR compared to WT mice (significant treatment × genotype interaction at 2 mg/kg).
outcomes.statistics: 0.5 mg/kg: treatment F(1,19)=57.16, p<0.001. 2 mg/kg: treatment F(1,19)=131.4, p<0.0001; genotype F(1,19)=10.06, p<0.005; post hoc SRKO vs WT p<0.005.
outcomes.evidence: 2 mg/kg DOI highly induced head-twitches (HTR; ***p < 0.001). Post hoc analysis showed that SRKO mice displayed a significantly lower induction of HTR compared to WT mice (##p < 0.005).

judge_notes: Single behavioural assay identified: Head-Twitch Response. c-fos mRNA, autoradiography, and HPLC measurements are non-behavioural and excluded per rubric.
Doses consolidated into one DOI compound entry with two dose levels (0.5 and 2 mg/kg).

D1 scored 1 (Multiple discrete sessions) because the first cohort was tested on two separate days in a crossover design; correspondingly D3 scored 2-7 days. GLM scored single-session; qwen/gptoss varied — judged based on explicit crossover statement.
B1 scored 0 (single measure: total HTR count) — overrode GLM's score of 1.
Direction set to 'increase' (the primary pharmacological effect of DOI on HTR); the SRKO genotype modulation is captured in summary/statistics but does not change primary direction.
food_restriction and water_restriction set to 'during' per rubric default for short standard tests where food/water not in apparatus.
